projects.title: 🏔️ Elite NEPSE AI Trading Agent
projects.subtitle: Autonomous Quant Trading Ensemble for NEPSE
projects.description: An institutional-grade self-improving AI quantitative trading agent built to crawl floorsheets, classify market regimes, and execute automated broker transactions.
achievements: Regime-Switching Ensemble: Dynamically tunes strategies (Momentum, Mean Reversion) mapped to volatile/bull/bear trends.
Concept Drift Block: Page-Hinkley cumulative sum algorithm registers rolling residuals to freeze allocations under high drift.
Autonomous Broker Execution: Automated TMS integration with headless crawler pipelines resolving session challenges.
Statistical Arbitrage: Co-integration analytics triggering pairs trades (e.g. NABIL vs NICA) on rolling spread Z-scores.
projects.architecture: [Live Data/Floorsheet] -> [Regime Classifier] -> [Self-Improving Brain] -> [Kelly Risk Sizer] -> [TMS Broker Execution]

projects.title: 🏛️ AI Autonomous Web Project Manager

projects.title: 🔌 Inverter Review AI
projects.subtitle: LangGraph-Driven Manufacturer Compliance Inspector
